description: A carved armoured-knight statue on a plinth from the Little Structures datapack, partly overtaken by vines and moss. A weathered-stone landmark piece in roughly the hero-ruin idiom.

style_fit.rationale: Same call as ls-wizard-statue: the right idiom, but overgrowth muddies the silhouette so it reads as a weak hero piece. A borderline fallback for an unfilled landmark slot; the monolith and temple set-pieces outrank it.
